question: What types can EnvFromSource reference to bulk-inject environment variables into a Container, and how are these alternatives expressed in the API schema?

ground_truth.answer: EnvFromSource defines a bulk source for environment variable injection into a Container. It can reference either a ConfigMapEnvSource (via configMapRef — injects all keys from a ConfigMap as environment variables) or a SecretEnvSource (via secretRef — injects all keys from a Secret). This is an ANY_OF union: the knowledge graph represents it with ANY_OF edges from EnvFromSource to each valid source type. An optional prefix field prepends a string to all injected variable names. The Container.envFrom field is a list of EnvFromSource objects, so multiple sources can be injected simultaneously.
context: io.k8s.api.core.v1.EnvFromSource: bulk source for environment variable injection; configMapRef or secretRef selects the data source (ANY_OF union); prefix prepends a string to all injected variable names
io.k8s.api.core.v1.ConfigMapEnvSource: selects a ConfigMap by name; all key-value pairs are injected as separate environment variables
io.k8s.api.core.v1.SecretEnvSource: selects a Secret by name; all key-value pairs are injected as separate environment variables
